sources.title: Meet 'North Mini Code': Cohere's 30B Open-Weight Mixture-of-Experts ...
sources.snippet: This week, Cohere AI team shipped its first developer-facing coding model named ' North Mini Code '. 'North Mini Code' is open-weight and focused at software engineers. It is a mixture-of-experts (MoE) model with 30B total parameters. Only 3B of those parameters activate per token. The release is positioned around "sovereign" AI.
